evidence.claim: Customer reported: Customer C13171 message: 'I never made this $55.68 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3558054.
Customer C13171 explicitly reported that they never made the $55.68 purchase (transaction 3558054) and requested an investigation into their card.

Disputed transaction 3558054 does not match any recurring payment pattern for holder C13171-K2|NA|170 (fewer than two prior similar charges) and was executed on device D008431, which was not present in the holder's 3 prior baseline transactions.
Disputed transaction 3558054 has an amount of $55.68 within the holder's prior observed maximum of $65.36 and matched the channel (online) and product category C of their baseline activity.
The bank's calibrated fraud model scored transaction 3558054 low at 0.105, reflecting a historical fraud rate of 21.17% in past cases with comparable scores (legacy real-time risk score 0.38).

Card C13171-K2 has a substantial history of 18 confirmed-fraud closed cases between July and October 2016 (including CC-5010, CC-4485, CC-4163, CC-3728, CC-3566, CC-3422), primarily involving card-not-present fraud, compared to only 1 cleared case (CC-4819).

Device D008431 has a generic desktop browser profile ('unknown | unknown | chrome 66.0 | unknown') associated with 175 cards all-time and 145 cards in the window, with zero closed fraud cases and no connection to a fraud ring (ring_id -1).
Card C13171-K2 belongs to Louvain community 163578122 with 4 cards, of which 2 carry confirmed-fraud cases, giving a community fraud rate of 50.0% and a lift vs base rate of 5.0.
Disputed transaction 3558054 occurred online without billing region data, which is typical for card C13171-K2 where 845 of 899 prior transactions also lacked regional information.
Disputed charge 3558054 ($55.68) occurred late in the evening at 22:08:56 on 2016-12-19, more than five hours after legitimate daytime purchases on the same holder identity.

Rule R2: Customer denies the transaction: Rule R2: Customer denies the transaction. Recommend `BLOCK_CARD` and `CREATE_CASE`. Add `FILE_REPORT` if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

case.summary: Customer C13171 disputed an online purchase of $55.68 (transaction 3558054) conducted on 2016-12-19 on card C13171-K2. The transaction utilized device D008431, which had not previously been associated with this holder, and did not reflect any recurring billing pattern. Card C13171-K2 carries significant prior compromise history, including 18 confirmed-fraud closed cases between July and October 2016. With direct customer denial and no positive exculpatory evidence of cardholder authorization, the charge is confirmed as card-not-present fraud. Card C13171-K2 was blocked and a case opened in accordance with bank policy.
